content.description: Illustration showing cylinder head valve assembly with springs and keepers

content.text: (b) Remove the valve keepers, retainers, springs and valves.
Keep valves in order for reinstallation in the same manner.
(c) Remove the valve stem oil seals.
(d) Using a small screwdriver or magnet, remove the valve spring seats.
1. CLEAN TOP OF PISTONS AND TOP OF BLOCK
(a) Turn the crankshaft and bring each piston to top dead center. Scrape the carbon from the piston top.

content.description: Illustration showing piston at top dead center being scraped to remove carbon deposits

content.text: (b) Remove all gasket material from the top of the block. Blow carbon and oil from the bolt holes.
Using a wire brush, remove all the carbon from the combustion chambers.
Be careful not to scratch the head gasket contact surface.

content.description: Illustration showing wire brush cleaning carbon from combustion chambers in cylinder head

content.text: Using a valve guide brush and solvent, clean all the valve guides.

content.description: Illustration showing valve guide brush being used to clean valve guide

content.text: Using a gasket scraper, remove all gasket materials from the manifold and head surface.

content.description: Illustration showing gasket scraper removing gasket material from cylinder head surface
